THE BMW PROJECT

The E46 Project was a project that spanned over a year and a half documenting a gynaecologist turned drift car builder. The project was commissioned by BMW and was a successful and unique project that we were honoured to take part in bringing to life.

JERUSALEM

IN COLLABORATION WITH WARNER BROTHERS DISCOVERY.

The Holy City bursting with history, sensational sites and rich culture.
From its magnificent architecture, its museums or cultural and religious joyful festival, let’s be enchanted by its magic through the lens of a talented photographer and tour guide enthusiast!

THE LEXUS PROJECT

The Lexus project was born out of a pure creative vision. One that touches on several real-time subjects while advertising the all new Lexus electric SUV. This project involved several months of pure passion to bring to life. It was shot in over 7 different locations throughout the Israeli desert. The project involved over 5 days of scouting, car rigs, nights in the hotel and sweaty days in the desert but it was all worth it for the team – the final result is amazing. Hope you enjoy!
